ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aloha checks the weather in your area to suggest the best time for your run.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Aloha reads your runs from Apple Health (time, distance, pace and heart rate) to tick off workouts in your plan and review how they went.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Aloha writes nothing to Apple Health – it only asks to read your runs. Apple requires this explanation from every app with Health access.
